caveat: Real historical backtest on NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP standard-processing archive rows. Truth labels come from documented events and land use at the window level; windows and bboxes were chosen from public reporting and must be verified before results are quoted. History is the 12 months before each window (no leakage).
verify: Coordinates and dates below are from public reporting as recalled by the analyst; check each bbox on a map before quoting results.
